Manages the fiscal operations of the clinic, including financial modelling based on changing healthcare environment and student population. (20% time)

Administers key student health care programs, including but not limited to student health, dental, and vision care insurance plans. Analyzes plan performance and utilization for the location. (20% time)
Develops and monitors operational and budget processes, staff FTE, finance, human resources and space planning. Manages systems and procedures to protect departmental assets. (15% time)
Manages, through staff, the daily operation of the unit with full responsibility for the outcome. (15% time)

Prepares short and long range planning for administrative services, clinic operations and improvements to processes. Plans and implements the use and update of clinical information systems. (10% time)
Establishes and recommends change to policies which affect the assigned unit(s). (5% time)
Serves as a representative of Health Care organization at campus meetings or committees. (5% time)

Special projects and Strategic Initiatives - Leads or supports special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by divisional leadership, including cross-functional efforts, operational improvements, and emerging priorities that support the goals of Student Affairs. Provides other duties as required. (5% time)

Manages divisional space planning activities, including space surveys, facility changes, and building-related issues. Attends monthly facilities manager meetings and coordinates space planning requests across the division. (5% time)

Comprehensive knowledge of clinical operations. Broad knowledge associated with managing medical care units and establishing operational efficiencies. Knowledge of health care delivery systems. Comprehensive knowledge of campus policies, programs and initiatives relating to Health Care services provided to students, faculty and staff.
Comprehensive knowledge of HR-related policies and procedures. Knowledge of union contracts and preparation of contract negotiations, in consultation with Human Resources.
Comprehensive knowledge of budget/fiscal related processes.
Skills in providing and managing the delivery of medical care services to a diverse client population.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to communicate effectively with students, faculty and staff at all levels in the organization, business partners and the medical community.
Must be able to collaborate with medical staff members and others across campus, both internal and external, at all levels in the organization on matters of significance.
Must have project management and organizational leadership skills.
Knowledge of practice operations, patient-scheduling systems, medical and insurance terminology, applicable information systems, patient service standards, and regulatory requirements.
Position must be able to establish priorities, goals and objectives and timelines for achievement of goals.
Broad knowledge of financial transactions and financial systems, as well as related policy, accounting, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Must be computer literate.
Knowledge and understanding of internal control practices and their impact on protecting University resources.
Skills in organization and customer service to effectively manage multiple important priorities.Proven ability to organize department work functions in an efficient and effective manner.
Broad knowledge of the organization's processes, protocols and procedures with a focus on budget, account and fund management and/or personnel management under labor contract(s) and personnel policy.
Skills to supervise support staff and to effectively establish and manage multiple priorities, goals and objectives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that serves a diverse client population.
Strong interpersonal communication skills to include verbal and written, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills.
Ability to work well with a diverse population of staff and students using tact, diplomacy,and maintaining strict confidentiality.
Demonstrated management and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others.
Proven ability to organize department work functions in an efficient and effective manner.
Broad knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques; human resources and risk management planning; and/or accounting and payroll.
